learnings: A single file audit failure due to transient API errors should not cascade into an 'inconclusive' package verdict if the file can be successfully audited by another model or if the failure is clearly a tool error rather than a security ambiguity.
Implement retry logic or fallback models for individual file audits to ensure complete coverage without requiring a full package re-audit.
